summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting a $600M private placement of 6.300% notes due 2031, sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-US persons under Regulation S. The notes mature August 19, 2031, are callable at make-whole prior to July 19, 2031, and then at par. Closing is expected May 19, 2026. Proceeds will fund investments, reduce borrowings, and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. There are no change-of-control provisions, tender offer, or restructuring elements. No risk-arb angle; watch for customary closing conditions only.
